description: Gather evidence for a question.

# Research

## When to use

Use this when a fictional question needs evidence before a decision.

## Outcome

Produce a concise account of the question, sources and findings.

## Inputs

Read the agreed question and identify permitted sources before gathering evidence.

## Procedure

Record the question, inspect the sources, distinguish observations from assumptions, and identify the next decision.

## Completion

Return the findings and remaining uncertainty for review without claiming a decision.
